name: Maximum induced path in a hypercube
definition: Find a longest induced path in the 9-dimensional hypercube Q9. The score is the number of edges in the path.
solution_format: An object with vertices, an ordered list of integer labels 0 through 511, where each label encodes a 9-bit vertex.
constraints: Every vertex label is an integer in [0, 512).
Every consecutive pair differs in exactly one bit.
Every nonconsecutive pair differs in at least two bits.
The objective is the number of consecutive edges, len(vertices)-1.
verification: Exact integer checks on all vertices and every vertex pair; no sampling or declared score is used.

source_review.definition: 固定Q9，最大化诱导路径的边数L，顶点数L+1；未把闭合coil或其他维数分别计成新任务。
source_review.primary_sources: 亲自读取Wynn1201.1647v1 SectionVI及完整190步列表，另读Orland等2607.15270v3（2026-09-30）§6、§8和AppendixE。主代理重新下载两篇原始HTML，逐个匹配全部190/191个转移索引，再从0逐步翻位重放，生成的191/192个顶点与保存列表完全一致。
source_review.provenance: 人类H190来自Wynn2012传统组合和置换搜索；公开191来自cube-surgery annealing。2026项目明确披露LLM协助论文、方法讨论、搜索代码和实验，未将其推断为这条具体见证的直接发现流程；未称191为已确认的非AI人类记录。
source_review.open_status: 2026v3明确9维为最小未知维数，并将192边蛇的存在列作开放问题。131个191边对称类为采样观察，未当作完备或最优证明。作者当前记录页Q9仍191，未用其他维数旧纪录。
source_review.independent_math: 逐顶点生成9个坐标翻转邻居，其在已选集合中的交集必须恰好等于路径前驱/后继；独立于正式检查器的全点对Hamming检查。额外推得保守上界：k顶点诱导路径外向边7k+2<=9(512-k)，故k<=287、L<=286；未声称这是最强文献上界。
source_review.controls: 五程序及完整控制通过，初始9、传统118、人类190、参考191、演化120。全部合法样例、闭合四环破坏、完整声明成绩不变性、严格回放、冷导出、程序错误/非有限数/超时均通过。
source_review.limits: 未重做原始大规模GPU/TPU搜索、对称类完备枚举或全局最优性证明。

source_review.definition: Maximize edge count of an induced path in Q_d. Keep d=9 and add10/11. No repeated vertices or nonconsecutive cube neighbors. Coils and snakepits are different objectives.
source_review.primary_source: Sol read Orland et al. arXiv2607.15270v3 Table1, exact optima known through dimension8, current paper constructions379 and746. The table footnote credits later750 to Echols2026a; it remains reported only in this archive. Paper discloses LLM assistance for search code. No global optimality proof for10/11 was found in checked sources.
source_review.witness_reconstruction: Sol fetched record_snakes.csv.zip at authors commit46c765399353a588ea50444a5d6610f53102b1c2, size16721566, Git blob SHA1 7854e2592325dab85a35a8a4809314edb80f7af8. Extracted the matching rows and verified every transition against saved vertices. Certified scores379 and746.
source_review.human_method: Wynn2012 190-edge Q9 path extended into Q10/Q11 by one endpoint move per new coordinate, giving191/192. In each added coordinate layer only the new endpoint is used, with exactly one neighbor in the preceding layer. This is a verified historical-method reconstruction and is weaker than the public record.
source_review.independent_method: Sol ran human and reference. Separate neighbor-set enumeration over all d coordinate flips verifies precisely the path edges. Check crossing count (d-2)m+2 <= d*(2^d-m), giving upper bounds567/1125 edges. Complete score-claim invariance, bad vertices, strict replay, cold isolated generation and failure controls passed.
source_review.admission: Five valid strict programs for all3 configs. Preserve original Q9 archives. Q11 formal public reference746; report750 remains separate.
